subject: Quick deadline question about the venue checklist
text:
Hi,

I’m trying to sort out what’s still open before tonight, and I got confused by the latest timeline. The venue checklist still shows as unfinished, but I assumed it was waiting on the final equipment list. Could you clarify whether the deadline I should follow is the one shown on the shared board or the revised time mentioned during yesterday’s call? If the checklist is actually late, tell me exactly what remains and who should handle it, because I want to stop assuming pieces are covered. Sorry if this is obvious; I’m moving between two sessions and don’t want to miss a step before the club event.
